title: Karthika Masam: Why We Light the Deepam and How to Do It at Home
intro: Karthika Masam is considered one of the holiest months for Shiva and Vishnu devotees. Lighting a lamp at dusk is the heart of the observance. Here is how families usually do it.

p: A lamp stands for knowledge dispelling darkness. In Karthika Masam, lamps are lit at home, at the tulasi plant, at temples and sometimes on water, as a prayer for light in life.
Use a clean clay or brass lamp with ghee or sesame oil. Light it at dusk near the tulasi plant or at the entrance of the home. Many people light an odd number of lamps.
Say a short prayer while lighting it. A simple one is enough, focused on peace for the family.
Mondays are dedicated to Shiva and Karthika Purnima, the full moon day, is the main festival. Many families also fast, visit temples and read or hear Puranic stories.
Dates vary by year, so check this year's panchang.
The point is regular remembrance. A single lamp lit calmly every evening is worth more than an elaborate ritual done in a hurry. Keep lamps safe around children and curtains.

faq.a: Usually between mid October and early December, depending on the lunar calendar. Check the panchang for exact dates.

faq.q: Can I light a lamp in an apartment?
faq.a: Yes, a small lamp in a safe spot near the entrance or puja area works well.
